summary: Addentax Group Corp. filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a share exchange on June 15, 2026. Through its Hong Kong subsidiary, it acquired a 41.67% stake in Riches Family Office Limited (Target) from Riches FO Holdings Limited and its sole shareholder, Mr. Wu Rui, the company’s COO. Consideration was 33,500 shares of Addentax common stock, issued under Regulation S (offshore, no U.S. person). No cash, premium, or board advisor named. The stake creates cross-ownership with management. Watch for minority-interest governance, potential consolidation, and any future buyout of the remaining stake.
